description: This PHP class 'CurlHandler' in the GuzzleHttp library implements an HTTP transport handler using cURL easy handles. It constructs cURL handles based on provided options and executes HTTP requests via cURL.

classes.name: CurlHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages HTTP requests using cURL easy handles, allowing custom configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with optional configuration, notably a handle factory.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the execution of an HTTP request using cURL and returns a Promise.
